template:
The following sentence contains the word "{word}":

"{prompt}"

Write a short word puzzle, a riddle or a clue of one or two sentences, whose answer is exactly the word "{word}" as it is used in the sentence. The puzzle must not contain the word, its plural or any form of it. Return only the puzzle, nothing else.

metadata.notes: Used by to_word_game (wording family): one call per marked word. The word is replaced by a bracketed placeholder in the request and the puzzle is listed beside it; wording_templates.json word_game_solve asks the model to solve the puzzles first.
